chunks: Al-Bazawfari from Humayd from Al-Hasan ibn Sam'ah from Ja'far from Ali ibn Uthman and Ishaq ibn 'Ammar from Sa'id ibn Yasar from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
I asked him about a man who has a female slave, and she has a daughter who is also a slave, and he buys her; is it permissible for him to have sexual relations with her? He said, 'No.'

key_terms.تَمْلِكُ الْكَوَّائِبِ: Owning the pubescent daughters (legal concept implied)
key_terms.يَطَأَهَا: To have sexual relations with her

ai.seo_question: Does owning a female slave automatically grant the right to have relations with her daughter if bought by the same owner?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the specific juristic ruling of 'tamlik al-kawā'ib' (owning the pubescent daughter) by establishing that a father's ownership of his female slave does not automatically extend to her minor daughter for sexual relations. This distinction highlights the independent legal status of the daughter in Shia fiqh, requiring separate acquisition or a distinct legal mechanism to permit intimacy, thereby refining the broader concept of concubinage.
